turns.question: What share of total non-cancelled order revenue from 17 August to 2 October 2026 came from the top three customers by revenue, in percent?
turns.answer: The semantic layer gives total non-cancelled revenue of 19,506.59 EUR for 17 August to 2 October 2026, and the top three customers by revenue (customer IDs 10, 2 and 1) brought in 2,356.00, 2,331.00 and 2,164.95 EUR. The layer has no top-customer share metric, so the percentage is my own arithmetic on these figures (about 35.1 percent), not a figure the layer returned. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
